purchaseOrderId.description: Unique Customer Id for the  Purchase Order

processingLocation.description:
The Asendia's location in where the physical package will be processed.
Possible values: SFO, MIA, JFK, PHL, ORD, LAX, SLC, TOR, CAL

accountNumber.description: Asendia's account number designated for the shipper. This will be provided at account setup.

htsNumber.description:
The Harmonized Tariff Schedule code required by international customs specifications.
See for more information: http://www.usitc.gov/tata/hts/index.htm

countryOfOrigin.description:
The 2-character ISO country code in which the product was manufactured, as required by international customs specifications.
See for more information: http://www.iso.org/iso/country_codes

leadTimeDays.description: The Number of days before an item can no longer be shipped

personalUseExemption.description:
Personal Use Exemption amount. This will set a max sales order quantity for the SKU.
Values greater than 0 will enable the Personal Use Exemption and become the new exemption value.
Value of 0 will apply no changes.
Value of -1 will disable the Personal Use Exemption for the SKU if one exists.

orderAlertThreshold.description:
If SKU quantity drops below this amount, an alert will be triggered.
Values greater than 0 will enable the Order Alert Threshold and become the new threshold value.
Value of 0 will apply no changes.
Value of -1 will disable all future threshold alerts for the SKU.

lotNumbered.description: Identifier for SKU to track expiration date

itemValue.description: Rate of the item for the customer

itemDescription.description: The item description that describes what the item is.

quantity.description: The total quantity of the product units within the package.

unitWeight.description: The total weight for a single unit of the product, in pounds.
